description: Live on-chain facts for any ERC-20 token on Base: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, owner address and whether ownership is renounced, paused state, proxy detection (EIP-1967 and minimal proxy) with implementation and admin addresses, and bytecode heuristics for mint, pause, blacklist and fee-setter functions.
